resources.string_add: Error messages not to record, one per line. * stands for any characters, and case does not matter.
Addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas or spaces.
For example, administrators, so your own visits don't count.
Path prefixes, or patterns with * (for example /page/*-admin), separated by commas or spaces.

The country, region and city that Cloudflare, Vercel or CloudFront add to each request. A CDN sets its own headers and passes the others through, so a visitor could send another CDN's: choose the CDN your site and NEO run behind.

Cookieless: a hash of the address and browser that changes daily, with nothing stored on the device. A guest who comes back another day counts as a new visitor. Persistent: a random id kept in the browser or app, which allows guest retention but may need consent.
Left out of stored page paths, so one page is not counted as many. Separate with commas; * matches any characters. Campaign tags and ad click ids are always left out.

How many pageviews, events, errors and timings the trackers may send from one address in a minute (an IPv6 address counts by its /64 network). More are dropped until the next minute, and the tracker keeps sending. Raise it when many visitors share one address, as in an office or a school. 0: no limit. Site actions and payments are never limited.

How many visits may start from one address in an hour (an IPv6 address counts by its /64 network). Hits that would start another visit are dropped, so a script cannot fill the reports with visits. Visits already running go on. 0: no limit.
Record the profile of signed-in members, for member sessions and retention. Deleting a profile unlinks its visits.
Visitors active within this time count as online.
Skip browsers that send Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control.
Older visits and events are deleted every hour.
A visit ends after this long without activity.
Sign-ups, logins, new profiles and content, comments, reactions and connections become events, with the client they came from.
Search engines, AI crawlers, AI assistants fetching pages, link previews, monitors and scripts. They are counted per day and page, apart from visitors.
JavaScript errors, unhandled promise rejections, failed requests and app crashes from every client. Query strings, tokens and emails are removed before anything is stored.
Web vitals of page loads (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB), and screen loads and starts in the apps.
Off stops collecting. Reports keep the data already collected.
Addresses or CIDR ranges of proxies and load balancers whose X-Forwarded-For header holds the visitor's address. Private network addresses and the NEO server are always trusted.
Measurements older than this are deleted. It can be shorter than the retention of other data, never longer.
From 0 to 100. Every measured page view adds a row, so a busy site can measure a part of them.
Any CDN's headers, the first one found
Hits per minute from one address
New visits per hour from one address
Couldn't load this report. Reload the page to try again.
This error is no longer stored.
No stack trace came with this error.
Other errors: more new kinds in an hour than the limit
A stack trace can show what a visitor typed or opened, so only those who may see visitor details can read it.
This period has too many pageviews to follow them all; the latest visits are shown.
{0} visitors from unknown locations are not on the map.

A page path starts with / or *, and * stands for any characters: *view-post* matches the post page on the site and in the apps. An action is an event name such as signup, or name@module for one module, for example content_add@bx_posts.
No orders paid with credits in this period.
No credits spent in this period.
No funnels yet. A funnel shows how many visits go through a series of steps and where they drop off.
No goals yet. A goal counts the visits that reach a page or an action, such as a sign-up or a new post.
No members visited in this period
No pageviews in the last 30 minutes
Pageviews per minute over the last 30 minutes
Pick a page in step 2 to see where visitors went after it.
Guests get a new id every day in cookieless mode, so they all look like new visitors here. Switch guest ids to persistent in Settings to follow them.
Amounts in {0} as recorded by the payment module, taxes included where the provider charged them. Orders paid with credits are counted under Credits.
The site takes payments in credits only, so revenue here is empty. See Credits for what credits paid for.
No payment module is active, so no new payments are recorded.
Payments in another currency with no exchange rate, left out of the totals: {0}.
Commission invoices issued in this period
No paying subscriptions at the start of the period
Site actions are not recorded (Settings > Track site actions)
Site actions are recorded (Settings > Track site actions)
Recorded from these alerts and from new content of every content module:
Any other client sends hits as JSON to the collect service with an API key (Studio > API). The payload is described in BxAnalyticsCollector.
See whether your own visits to the site are recorded, and what the server sees of this browser. The check stores nothing.
Site actions are recorded on the server, on the platform of the request that did them. Core is for cron and other jobs without a request.
Automatic: the tracker script is added to every page of the classic site.
Not recorded: bots, members of excluded levels, browsers that ask not to be tracked (when the site respects it), excluded addresses and paths. Studio pages have no tracker.
Names are up to 64 letters, digits, spaces and _ . : / -. Properties are short text, numbers or true and false, up to 2 KB in all.
In server code call track, not collect: collect records the server's own address and user agent as an API client.
The tracker is not added to pages: its injection (bx_analytics_tracker) is off
The tracker is added to pages
Built in: NEO reads its settings from get_tracker_config and sends hits to the collect service. Their last hits are in the table above.
API access by key or by origin is on
The test event was not stored: this browser isn't tracked. Check this browser to see why.
The test event was stored: it is in Events as analytics_setup_test, and the status table is updated.
The test event goes through the real collector, so it adds a visit from you to the reports.
Tracking is off: nothing is recorded on any platform.
Step {0}: page path or action name
Metrics: pick one for the chart and the tables
Credits figures are for all platforms: the modules that keep credits don't record where a member was.
Credits were spent on checkouts the revenue ledger doesn't have yet, so they aren't listed by what they paid for. Importing past payments adds them.
The download has the first {0} of {1} rows.
The page could not be created. Enter a title of up to 100 characters and try again.
The page gets the filter bar, key figures and top lists, shown on the site and in NEO, and opens in the page builder.
Pages created here belong to Analytics: disabling the module removes them with their blocks.
No site page has analytics blocks.
Site pages with analytics blocks. Add blocks to any page in the page builder, or start a new analytics page here.
In NEO counts the blocks NEO and the apps show. The others show on the classic site only.
Parameters must be a JSON object, such as {"range": "7d"}.
The API is off (Studio > API), so other clients can't call get_report. The playground still runs reports here.
Try get_report, the service NEO and other clients read reports from. It runs here as you, with your permissions, and answers with the same JSON as api.php.
API access by key and by origin are both off, so api.php refuses every client. The playground still runs reports here.
This report has no parameters of its own.
Filters and the report's own parameters, for example {"range": "30d", "platform": "next-web", "f": {"country": "US"}}.
Only the first 1 MB is shown.
A date, YYYY-MM-DD, with the custom range.
Filters as an object of dimension and value. Dimensions: {0}.

Your address has sent more than the limits allow (Settings > Hits per minute, New visits per hour). Its hits are dropped until the next minute, or new visits until the next hour.
Visits from this browser are recorded

Fill in 2 to 6 steps in the order visitors take them. A visit counts for a step when it reaches that step after the previous one. Each step is a page path (*view-post* for the post page on every platform) or an action (signup, content_add@bx_posts).
Enter a name and 2 to 6 steps. Page paths start with / (or *); action names use letters, digits and _ . : / -
Enter a name and a page path that starts with / (or *), or an action name of letters, digits and _ . : / -
